samples.description: Settings page with explicit Context composition
Stacked modal sessions and restored focus
Typed arguments, ordinary ScrollRect and CacheOne
Navigation, dialogs, popup queue and per-session presenters
Optional Addressables SDK: Registry routing, local Bundle, cache and cancellation.
Optional DOTween SDK: Fade/Scale/Slide and paired Host presets; SDK installation is separate.
Optional R3 SDK: native uGUI bindings owned by each UI session; SDK installation is separate.
Optional FancyScrollView 1.9.0: bounded fixed-size cells, asynchronous reuse and session cancellation.
